notes: aspect_right / aspect_center / aspect_left ("Right Aspect", "Center Aspect", "Left Aspect") have zero usages in the app; only the generated localization accessor references them. They look like longer labels that were superseded by chip_right/chip_center/chip_left in the tapped-point pop-up. Kept in order under the trailing unused section — removing them is a product decision.

diagram_title and diagram_subtitle are used two ways: on the standalone Subtle System screen they are the real text, but when the diagram is embedded in the post-meditation summary a CMS-set heading/subheading overrides them. The description says this in plain words rather than calling it a fallback.

The same YAML block also holds worked_on_title / worked_on_subtitle, which were not assigned to this leaf — presumably they live on a meditation-summary leaf. Worth confirming they are covered somewhere.

description: The screen that introduces Shri Mataji's talks before a video plays. It comes in two looks: the ordinary intro (used from Explore, from the daily meditation, and when opening one specific clip), and a separate portrait version shown once, right after someone finishes their first meditation.

order.description: Heading at the top of the intro, naming the talks. Shown on every version except the one after the first meditation.
Short line under the heading. Only shown when the intro is for one particular video clip, including when it is opened from the daily meditation.
The long paragraph about Shri Mataji, below her photo. Not shown on the short single-clip version of the intro.
Label of the button at the bottom that opens the video. The running time is added in brackets after it automatically. Shown on every version except the one after the first meditation.

notes: Two clearly distinct variant sets. The post_first_meditation_* keys plus start and maybe_later belong exclusively to the portrait screen shown after someone's first meditation; every other variant (Explore intro, daily-meditation intro, single-clip intro) uses title / clip_description / generic_description / watch_now.
The 'Learn from the source' label above the heading on the daily-meditation version comes from a different leaf (home.daily), not from here.

notes: play and pause have zero usages in the app — the player's controls are icon-only with no visible or spoken text label. Kept under the trailing unused section; removing them (or wiring them up as accessibility labels, which would be the better fix) is a product decision.
replay is the only playback label in real use, and it is used on the vibes-check screen rather than on the full talk player. The description says where it actually appears.

The six language names are shown in whatever order the talk's own subtitle tracks come back in, so the order in this editor does not control the on-screen order. "Off" is always the first entry. A talk with a subtitle language not in this list shows the raw language code in capitals instead.
